citation.title: MitoQ supplementation augments acute exercise-induced increases in muscle PGC1α mRNA and improves training-induced increases in peak power independent of mitochondrial content and function in untrained middle-aged men

population.description: Placebo group of the parallel trial (Table 1, mean +/- SD, n = 11): untrained healthy middle-aged men, non-smokers, free of injury and chronic illness including cardiovascular and metabolic disease, doing under 2 h physical activity per week. Only the placebo group is entered; the MitoQ group (n = 12) is not. The paper does not print n beside Table 2; n = 11 is the placebo group size of Table 1 and Results say results are for the 23 who completed the acute trial. VO2peak of the placebo group (ramp-incremental cycle test to exhaustion; Table 1, mean +/- SD): 'VO2peak (ml/kg/min) 39.1 +/- 7.4' under 'Placebo group (n = 11)'.

protocols.name: placebo_hiit_bout
protocols.description: Placebo arm of the acute high-intensity interval bout, cycle ergometer, after a 10 h overnight fast ('arrived at the laboratory following a 10 h overnight fast'; cannulation and a biopsy come before minute 0, so the fast at minute 0 was a little longer, not printed). No meals: the placebo tablet (tapioca, silica, cellulose) was taken 30 min before breakfast daily, and the paper does not say breakfast was eaten before the bout. Bout: 10 x 60 s work intervals each followed by 75 s at 30 W, so interval k starts at 135 (k-1) s; starts are floored to whole minutes 0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13, 15, 18, 20 (the 5th, 540-600 s, is exactly minute 9-10), with 30 W filling the minutes between. The real bout lasts 21.25 min; minute 21-22 is the first minute after it (no cool-down printed), where the sample 'immediately after exercise' is placed. Work level from the placebo group's measured VO2 in the 5th interval, Table 2: (33.4 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.9369 (237 W / 186 = 1.27 is above the scale, so VO2 is used). Recovery level 30 / 186 = 0.1613. Clock hour not printed (8.0 assumed).

findings.description: Mean heart rate recorded during the fifth work interval (minutes 9 to 10 of the bout), placebo group
Plasma lactate immediately after the bout (the first minute after the last work interval, minutes 21 to 22 of the arm), placebo group

location.where: Table 2, Placebo column (mean +/- SD); Results: 'plasma lactate measured immediately after exercise'

left_out.what: MitoQ-group heart rate, VO2 and post-exercise lactate (Table 2): a supplement arm, only the placebo is entered
Blood samples midway through exercise and 15 min, 1, 2 and 3 h after (Methods): lactate and other values at these times are not printed in a table or the text
Rest (pre-exercise) lactate: the text says only an approximately 11-fold increase in plasma lactate from rest, no resting value is printed
Training-phase results (20 km time trial, VO2peak, peak power, citrate synthase, respiration) after three weeks of HIIT
